decided_by: Malcolm, 2026-08-25 — chose FLWFIX nbp_flash_01 to replace the faulty-label banner
note:
Swaps ONLY the two images on this banner, leaving every section setting exactly as it is.

Why so narrow: this collection's template was not built through publish-collection-banner-template.py — it has no PAGES entry there — so re-running that publisher would rebuild it from the shared default and silently discard whatever tuning it carries (text position, overlay, the custom-html measure). That is the same trap that dropped allow_transparent_header on two other pages today. A targeted image_assignments patch touches nothing else.

The settings being preserved, for the record: desktop text centre-RIGHT, mobile text bottom-centre, overlay 22, parallax off, image_size sm, transparent header on.
